Dear Hiring Committee,

I am writing to express my interest in the Education Program Coordinator position at Fundación Aprender. As a STEM educator with three years of experience, I have developed a strong foundation in teaching, workshop facilitation, scheduling, and the practical coordination required to create engaging learning experiences.

In my current role as a STEM teacher, I have designed and delivered 20 STEM workshops. This experience has strengthened my ability to organize educational activities, guide participants through hands-on learning, and adapt sessions to support clear and meaningful outcomes. It has also given me an appreciation for the importance of thoughtful planning, reliable documentation, and effective communication in the delivery of successful programs.

I am particularly motivated by the opportunity to help scale hands-on learning programs. Fundación Aprender’s Education Program Coordinator role appeals to me because it brings together program coordination and educational impact—areas that closely align with both my experience and professional interests. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my classroom perspective while supporting the planning, documentation, communication, and scheduling involved in delivering strong programs.

I am a committed educator who values organized implementation, collaboration, and accessible learning. I would be pleased to bring my experience facilitating STEM workshops and coordinating educational activities to Fundación Aprender.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background and motivation could support your programs.

Sincerely,
Ana López
